questions.prompt: A batch job reads a million keys once each. What happens to an LRU cache?
options: Every genuinely hot key is pushed out

questions.prompt: Why do popular keys survive a scan under LFU?
options: One-off reads never catch up with their counts
Yesterday's popular key keeps its count forever unless counts age

questions.prompt: Which policy evicts whatever has gone longest without use? (three letters)
What does W-TinyLFU (used by Caffeine) do?
options: Admits a new key only if a frequency sketch says it's more popular than the eviction victim

questions.prompt: TTL-based expiry bounds staleness rather than memory.
How does Redis implement LRU and LFU?
options: Approximately, by sampling a few keys
